deadlines.label: Deadline for submitting previous education certificate, 2027/2028
deadlines.quote: Deadline for applicants to submit their previous education certificate is September 30th, 2027.

deadlines.label: Extended final deadline for a copy of the BA diploma, 2027/2028
deadlines.quote: Applicants who are unable to get their foreign diploma recognized/nostrified until the end of September are allowed to submit a copy of their BA diploma no later than October 22nd, 2027.

prerequisites.quote: Applicants are required to submit proof of English competency at min. B2 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).
